categories.main_business_segments: Xinyi Glass Holdings Limited operates primarily in three business segments: float glass, automobile glass, and architectural glass. The company also produces related products such as rubber plastic parts and components for advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs advanced float glass production lines with automation and connected production processes. It uses energy-efficient and environmentally friendly technologies including rooftop distributed solar power generation and low-temperature recycling residual heat power co-generation systems. The company also focuses on R&D for new materials, coatings, and advanced glass products with features like low-e coatings and energy-saving structures.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Group serves customers in over 140 countries, including the PRC, Hong Kong, the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas. Customers include automobile glass manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, car manufacturers, architectural and furniture glass manufacturers, and float glass distributors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group's operations are concentrated in Greater China (including the PRC and Hong Kong) and Malaysia, with expanding production facilities in Indonesia. Sales are global, covering Asia, Europe, the Americas, Africa, and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xinyi Glass operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the glass supply chain, manufacturing float glass, automobile glass, and architectural glass products. It also has upstream integration through ownership of silica sand mines and processing facilities to secure raw materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group prioritizes R&D in new glass products, advanced coatings, automation, and production efficiency improvements. It emphasizes carbon neutrality, energy conservation, and development of high value-added and differentiated glass products. Expansion of overseas production capacity and flexible marketing strategies are also key focuses.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of float glass, automobile glass, and architectural glass. The company also earns rental income from investment properties and sales of electricity generated from solar power systems.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xinyi Glass is a leading player in the global glass industry with a strong market position supported by economies of scale, diversified product mix, and integrated production facilities. It competes globally in automotive and architectural glass markets, leveraging advanced technology and geographic expansion to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, the Group reported revenue of RMB22.3 billion, a decrease of 8.1% from 2023, and net profit attributable to equity holders of RMB3.37 billion, down 31%. The company has a solid financial position with total assets of RMB48.1 billion and equity of RMB34.3 billion. The five-year compound annual growth rate of sales is 7.6%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xinyi Glass emphasizes product quality, innovation, and environmental sustainability. It offers a wide range of differentiated glass products with advanced coatings, energy-saving features, and specialized automotive glass components. The Group’s vertical integration, automation, and global production footprint provide cost advantages and supply chain control, enhancing customer value.
